Hi Ellen — great to chat this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on security gating items you raised.

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: patient data enrichment pipelines (no storage of raw PHI on Redwood by default; transient processing).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter for ongoing coverage, data residency / HIPAA controls, and completion of your vendor security questionnaire (DDQ).

Next steps I can own from our side:
1) Share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a draft bridge letter for legal review.
2) Provision temporary secure access to our Trust Portal so your security team can pull artifacts (I can create a read-only bucket if you prefer S3-style access).
3) Kick off the DDQ — if you can send the latest spreadsheet we’ll fill it out and flag items that need deeper review.

Timeline: I expect we can upload the redacted Type II and bridge letter within 1-2 business days once we have your NDA in place. Portal access can be provisioned same day if you confirm preferred access method.

Can you confirm: 1) whether we should send the NDA/DocuSign to you or to Tom in procurement, and 2) whether the Trust Portal link or an S3 transient bucket is preferred?

I’ve attached the MedLinx DDQ you mentioned (from the drive link you shared) to keep everything in one thread.

Thanks —
Grace
